title: AI Desktop Assistant
summary: Voice-enabled AI assistant built with Python, PyQt, and DeepSeek API.

title: Real Estate Web App (Locatech)
summary: Full-stack platform for listing, searching, and chatting about properties in Morocco.
description:
🎯 Locatech – Real Estate Web Platform for the Moroccan Market 🇲🇦

After 2 months of collaborative development with Saad Baouli, we’re proud to introduce Locatech — a full-stack real estate web application built specifically for buying and renting properties in Morocco.

Unlike marketplace platforms like Airbnb, Locatech focuses on helping users find their future homes, villas, or apartments with support for real-time communication, multi-role access, and AI-powered property suggestions.

🛠️ Tech Stack
Frontend: React.js · Tailwind CSS · Redux
Backend: Laravel (main API), Node.js + Express.js (chat server), WordPress (blog system)
Databases: MySQL (users, listings), MongoDB (chat)
Real-Time: Socket.io (messaging + notifications)
AI Assistant: DeepSeek API (smart property suggestions)

👥 Platform Roles & Features
- Client: Browse, filter, and view detailed property listings, chat with courtiers, and provide feedback.
- Courtier: Post and manage properties with approval rules depending on agency level.
- Assistant: Moderates listings, conversations, and confirms deal reports.
- Admin: Manages all roles, blog content, and configurations.

💡 What We Learned
Locatech challenged us to bring together diverse technologies into one platform, balancing UX, data flow, and real-time features.

description:
🚀 Introducing LearCodeLab: A Full-Stack Educational Platform Built by Future Developers 💡

Our team:
Saad Baouli
YASSIR EL MAHDAOUI
Riyad El Benna
Mouhssine Dwissy

🧠 What is LearCodeLab?
It’s a modern, full-featured educational platform designed specifically for students (stagiaires), instructors (formateurs), and administrators. Our mission? To learn, practice, and share knowledge in an environment that feels both familiar and powerful.

🧩 Key Features:
✅ Role-Based Dashboard: Custom dashboards for students, instructors, and admins.
✅ Social Learning Experience: Inspired by platforms like Facebook — users can create and interact with content we call collections: Share ideas, problems, and solutions, React (upvote/downvote) and comment on collections, Save collections as favorites.
✅ Real-Time Collaboration: Group Rooms, Live Notifications powered by Socket.io.
✅ Built-In Code Editor: Monaco Editor.
✅ Global Search Engine.
✅ Theming & Personalization: 9+ UI themes.
✅ Resource Hub: Curated learning resources shared by admins.

🛠 Tech Stack:
Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS
Backend: Laravel
Real-Time: Socket.io
Editor: Monaco

🎓 Built with passion and teamwork, LearCodeLab represents the culmination of our 2-year journey as future full-stack developers. It's not just a school project — it's a platform built by learners, for learners.

We’re excited to keep pushing forward, and this is just the beginning. 🌱
